description:
Make archive preview and `archive candidates` read each target's prior executions from its evidence record through storage, once per target, instead of reading the event log.

## Background

Preview and `archive candidates` read the whole event log once per target through `IssueStore::read_artifact_archive_events` (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:178,248`; trait default `storage/mod.rs:245-256`; file backend `storage/json.rs:1328-1364`). Each target's executions are in `archive-evidence/<target-key>.json`. Command tests plant prior executions as events (`commands/archive.rs:1050-2226`). Both integration-test `IssueStore` wrappers implement the trait (`tests/fast_docs_templates/template_apply_atomicity_tests.rs`, `tests/fast_rules/local_rule_enforcement_tests.rs`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Preview and `archive candidates` read each target's evidence record once through a new `IssueStore` method implemented by both backends and both test wrappers, and read no event-log content.
- [hard] REQ-02: Preview tests plant prior executions as evidence records, and a test shows that preview of a re-archived target succeeds with an unparseable event log and reports the same coverage as before.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Archive preview reads the per-target evidence record
